mapper.select: SELECT command_id, tenant_id, device_id, requested_by, operation, payload, status, failure_code, requested_at, expires_at, dispatched_at, acknowledged_at, completed_at, version FROM device_command WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND command_id = #{commandId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_command(command_id, tenant_id, device_id, requested_by, operation, payload, status, failure_code, requested_at, expires_at, dispatched_at, acknowledged_at, completed_at, version) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{tenantId}, #{deviceId}, #{requestedBy}, #{operation}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{failureCode}, #{requestedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{dispatchedAt}, #{acknowledgedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{version})

INSERT INTO command_status_outbox(id, tenant_id, topic, partition_key, payload, status, attempts, available_at, occurred_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{topic}, #{partitionKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), 'PENDING', 0, #{occurredAt}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, topic, partition_key, payload::text AS payload FROM command_status_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= now() ORDER BY relay_sequence FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE command_status_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE command_status_outbox SET attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, available_at = now() + make_interval(secs => LEAST(300, CAST(power(2, LEAST(attempts, 8)) AS integer))) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
